articles.summary: WESTLAKE, Texas, June 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Goosehead Insurance, Inc. (“Goosehead” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: GSHD), a rapidly growing, independent personal lines insurance agency, today announced the appointment of Eben Hewitt as Chief Technology Officer.
articles.title: Goosehead Insurance, Inc. Names Eben Hewitt as Chief Technology Officer
